description: Drone Pilot (Junior) responsible for capturing aerial images, videos, and data for various industries. Their roles include tasks like surveying land, inspecting infrastructure, and monitoring agriculture or wildlife. They may also assist in providing security surveillance. The job requires technical skill, attention to detail, and knowledge of drone regulations.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Interpret DGCA Safety Regulations observe safety guidelines, ATC procedures, Radio Telephony, Weather and meteorology as a RPA Pilot in flying a RPA.
Identify and select different types of RPA and illustrate Fundamentals of Flight (Aerodynamics) and Different Airframes in RPA flying.
Identify and select various parts of RPA like assembling Electric motors, Batteries, Chargers, Connectors, etc.
Identify and compare the weathereffects and analyze the performance of RPA.
Perform installation, maintain and configuration of ground control station software.
Perform preflight inspection and assembling of basic RPA parts like landing gears, propellers, antennas and any wire / electronics hanging outside.
Carryout basic training to fly RPA in flight simulator.
Plan and organize training to fly RPA in controlled environments.
Perform and obtain training to fly RPA in uncontrolled airspace including VLOS and BVLOS flight.
Apply emergency protocols to control and manage RPA flight.
